Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: production pixel-art sprite animation sheet for a native 64x64 square-grid roguelike.
Input image 1 is the exact character identity and appearance master. Image 2 is a PLAYER movement/projection guide, not the subject.
Draw The unarmed masked cultist from image 1: pointed charcoal hood with burgundy lining, narrow ivory face mask, dark charcoal coat, burgundy central tabard and cuffs, black gloves and boots. Keep exactly two empty hands; preserve its compact adult build and original face mask.
Task: remake ONLY locomotion while preserving the master appearance, proportions, painted lighting, materials and crisp pixel clusters.
Direction: walking TOWARD the viewer, south/down, true FRONT view in all first eight cells, same slight elevated game projection as reference.
Layout: exactly 3 columns by 3 rows of equal square cells, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom, large transparent margins, full entire figure centered in each cell. Transparent background alpha zero, no text, labels, lines, floor, shadows or other characters. Suggest 1536 square output. Same figure scale in every cell.
Animation: first EIGHT cells are eight DISTINCT coherent whole-body poses over two alternating steps: 1 left foot contact reaching forward, right foot trails; 2 weight settles over left support; 3 right foot passes close underneath hip with low knee lift; 4 right foot reaches toward next contact; 5 opposite/right contact; 6 weight settles on right; 7 left foot passes close underneath hip; 8 left foot reaches to repeat pose1 seamlessly. Ninth cell is relaxed front stance, ignored by the walking loop.
Foot movement must describe genuine forward/backward steps in this game projection, clear alternating planted and passing feet. Narrow natural stance; no side-to-side splaying, high knees, scissoring or dancing. Head fixed firmly to torso, subtle shoulder balance, minimal bob. Match the grounded player's readable small steps: 400ms each step, 800ms full cycle. The guide repeats a settling pose, but your eight poses must all be distinct.
Keep all anatomy connected with correctly bent knees and ankles, whole garments with plausible folds, no sliding cut-out body bands. Keep feet visible below the tabard, with hem following the legs.
Style: exact established reference sprite style, hand-painted dark pixel art, bold clean silhouette and selective highlights at native 60–78px figure height. Not a smooth illustration, no blur, glow, new accessories, outfit redesign or brighter exposure.
